CityHaldwani operates solely as an independent classified advertising platform with a zero-tolerance policy for fraud, scams, or unverified listings. The platform strictly enforces a **"No Online Advance Payment"** policy—all transactions are handled directly with companions via cash on delivery upon in-person verification.

- **Platform URL:** https://cityhaldwani.in/
